code: flight_modes <- ssf_taxonomy(   name = "flight_modes",   labels = c("Circling-like flight", "Directed flight"),   order_by = "persistence",   rules = function(states) {     p <- setNames(states$metrics$persistence, rownames(states$metrics))     c(persistence_gap = p[["Directed flight"]] - p[["Circling-like flight"]] > 1,       forward_persistence = p[["Directed flight"]] > 0)   } )  result <- fit_guided_ssf(   steps, convention = "area", normalization = "exact",   taxonomies = list(flight_modes, "Other"),   persistence_bounds = c(.05, .995),   n_starts = 8, short_iter = 100, long_iter = 900, seed = 1729 ) print(result) #> Guided SSF: selected (flight_modes) #>   flight_modes: accepted result$history$flight_modes$assessment$checks #>           converged             hessian               score        valid_kernel  #>                TRUE                TRUE                TRUE                TRUE  #>          transition           occupancy         state_order     persistence_gap  #>                TRUE                TRUE                TRUE                TRUE  #> forward_persistence  #>                TRUE stopifnot(identical(result$taxonomy, "flight_modes")) assessment <- result$assessment fit <- result$fit gps$state <- factor(assessment$labels[fit$state], levels = flight_modes$labels) probabilities <- as.data.frame(fit$posterior) names(probabilities) <- assessment$labels  state_summary <- data.frame(   State = assessment$labels,   Steps = tabulate(fit$state, nbins = fit$n_states),   Share = round(100 * assessment$occupancy, 1),   `Mean length (m)` = round(1000 * assessment$metrics$mean_step, 1),   Persistence = round(assessment$metrics$persistence, 2),   check.names = FALSE ) names(state_summary)[3] <- "Share (%)" knitr::kable(state_summary, row.names = FALSE)

code: anchors <- lapply(c(A = 9871L, B = 1729L), function(seed) {   fit_ssf(steps, n_starts = 8, short_iter = 100, long_iter = 900,     seed = seed, normalization = "exact") })  tpm <- function(p) rbind(c(p[1], 1 - p[1]), c(1 - p[2], p[2])) broad <- function() {   limits <- log(stats::quantile(steps$step, c(.1, .9), names = FALSE))   mean <- sort(exp(stats::runif(2, limits[1], limits[2])))   shape <- exp(stats::runif(2, log(.5), log(6)))   list(coefficients = rbind(step = -shape / mean, log_step = shape - 2,     cos_angle = stats::runif(2, -1.2, 1.2)),     transition = tpm(stats::runif(2, .2, .94))) } near <- function(fit, spread) {   b <- stats::coef(fit)   i <- order(movement_metrics(b, "area")$mean_step)   b <- b[, i, drop = FALSE]   b["step", ] <- -exp(log(-b["step", ]) + stats::rnorm(2, sd = spread))   b["log_step", ] <- exp(log(b["log_step", ] + 2) + stats::rnorm(2, sd = spread)) - 2   b["cos_angle", ] <- b["cos_angle", ] + stats::rnorm(2, sd = spread)   self <- stats::plogis(stats::qlogis(diag(fit$transition)[i]) +     stats::rnorm(2, sd = spread))   list(coefficients = b, transition = tpm(self)) }  family <- rep(c("Package starts", "Broad starts", "Near A", "Near B"), c(48, 48, 40, 40)) seeds <- 60000L + seq_along(family) spreads <- c(rep(c(.5, 1), each = 24), rep(NA_real_, 48),   rep(rep(c(.10, .25), each = 20), 2)) starts <- lapply(seq_along(seeds), function(i) {   set.seed(seeds[i])   switch(family[i],     "Package starts" = list(seed = seeds[i], spread = spreads[i]),     "Broad starts" = list(initial_values = broad()),     "Near A" = list(initial_values = near(anchors$A, spreads[i])),     "Near B" = list(initial_values = near(anchors$B, spreads[i]))) }) names(starts) <- family
